instruction: Open the ArXiv PDF page for the first paper (StarCoder 2) listed in the document. The ArXiv link is recorded at the end of that paper's entry.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent tried to access huggingface.co to find daily papers but encountered ERR_TIMED_OUT and certificate errors. After bypassing certificate warning, was redirected to unrelated JEIFM radio station. Spent all 47 turns retrying and attempting alternative approaches (curl, different URLs) but never accessed Huggingface or modified the docx.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, type URLs in address bar, reload pages, interact with certificate warnings, use terminal for curl commands, switch between Chrome and LibreOffice Writer
metadata.failure_analysis: Huggingface.co was inaccessible in the VM environment due to network/proxy issues. The certificate was invalid (from player.jeifm.com), indicating DNS/proxy misconfiguration. The model could not complete the task because the required website was unreachable.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to navigating to an ArXiv PDF URL that is already recorded in the document. ArXiv is typically accessible and the URL is provided in the docx, avoiding the Huggingface dependency.
metadata.explanation: Task requires reading the ArXiv PDF link from the opened document and navigating to it in Chrome. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the ArXiv pattern for paper 2402.19173.

scoring_breakdown.navigation: 1.0 - Active URL matches ArXiv pattern for 2402.19173

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL, which is the right state to verify navigation to a specific page.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict from get_rule and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex pattern list. Data flow is correct.
Expected regex pattern '.*arxiv\.org.*2402\.19173.*' correctly identifies the StarCoder 2 paper (ArXiv ID 2402.19173) and will match any ArXiv URL containing this paper ID.
Single-step task (navigate to URL) with single verification check - coverage is complete.

Minor: Instruction specifies 'ArXiv PDF page' but regex also accepts the abstract page (arxiv.org/abs/...). This is acceptable since reaching any ArXiv page for the correct paper demonstrates task completion.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional: To strictly verify PDF page, pattern could be '.*arxiv\.org/pdf/2402\.19173.*' instead of the broader match, but current pattern is reasonable.
